title: Addressing the Deep researcher
description: How to write for a reader acting as Deep researcher. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `deep-researcher` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Cite to a location, and mark a synthesis as one
rules.description: Cite to a location, not to a document — the page a claim was made on, so a reader can verify it where it was made rather than being sent to a PDF. Distinguish what a source says from what it implies, and never let a synthesis read as a quotation.

source.quote: Cites to a location, not to a document. Distinguishes what a source says from what it implies, and marks a synthesis as a synthesis rather than letting it read as a quotation.
